crossRefs.note: The commanding officer answered, “I bought my citizenship for a great price.” Paul said, “But I was born a Roman.”

people.name: Paul
people.line: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

translations.web: The commanding officer answered, “I bought my citizenship for a great price.” Paul said, “But I was born a Roman.”
translations.bsb: “I paid a high price for my citizenship,” said the commander. “But I was born a citizen,” Paul replied.
translations.kjv: And the chief captain answered, With a great sum obtained I this freedom. And Paul said, But I was free born.
translations.asv: And the chief captain answered, With a great sum obtained I this citizenship. And Paul said, But I am a Roman born.
